testCases.error: Keyboard focus escaped active aria-modal="true" container onto background page header link.

defect.title: Focus escapes modal dialog boundary onto background navigation link
stepsToReproduce: Launch application and open the Defect Review or Confirmation modal.
Press Tab key sequentially through "Cancel" and "Confirm Purchase" buttons.
Press Tab once more past the final interactive button.
Observe focus indicator escaping modal boundary onto background <a class="logo-link">.
defect.expectedResult: Focus must remain strictly trapped within modal boundary as required by WCAG 2.1 SC 2.1.2 (No Keyboard Trap).
defect.actualResult: ActiveElement escaped modal boundary and focused background element: <a class="logo-link" href="/" tabindex="0">.
defect.errorLogs:
[Axe-Core Audit Report]
Rule: "focus-order-semantics" (Severity: Serious / Blocker)
Target Element: div.dialog-overlay > div.modal-content
Expected Boundary: <dialog aria-modal="true">
ActiveElement: <a class="logo-link" href="/" tabindex="0">

Failure Stack:
at evaluateFocusTrap (lib/a11y/focusAudit.ts:84:14)
at runAccessibilitySuite (tests/specs/web-suite.spec.mjs:188:9)

aiTriage.rootCause: Focus escaped active aria-modal="true" container onto background interactive DOM node.
aiTriage.recommendedFix: Implement keyboard focus wrap listener on keydown (Tab / Shift+Tab) or use HTML5 <dialog> with showModal().

testCases.title: REST API Health & JSON Response Payload Schema
testCases.message: API route response verified: HTTP 200, application/json, valid payload schema.

testCases.title: Client Runtime Error Boundary & Unhandled Rejection Guard
